name: Feasibility & Massing Tool
tagline: End-to-end browser-based feasibility and massing tool for site development projects.
description: A web application that allows users to draw a site, apply NBC + Telangana GO rules, generate massing, export geometry to Rhino/Grasshopper, and download a PPTX deck. It supports project types like highrise, mid-rise, villa township, mixed-use, and more.

page.objective: End-to-end browser-based feasibility and massing tool for site development projects.
page.solution: A web application that allows users to draw a site, apply NBC + Telangana GO rules, generate massing, export geometry to Rhino/Grasshopper, and download a PPTX deck. It supports project types like highrise, mid-rise, villa township, mixed-use, and more.

highlights.headline: Site to massing to PPTX deck — 7 of 7 tests pass.
points: Applies NBC + Telangana GO setback and FAR rules automatically per plot.
Exports massing straight to Rhino/Grasshopper via a GhPython bridge recipe.
v1 spine only — shadow, wind, and solar analysis are still v2.
